method_improvements_over_1e21_certificat.functional_equation_pairing: The positive-ordinate multiset is invariant under beta -> 1-beta. Convexity gives sum x^(beta-1)w_gamma <= (1+x^-1)/2 sum w_gamma; conjugates then double this bound.
method_improvements_over_1e21_certificat.direct_HSW_Stieltjes_tail: The full HSW main term and error are integrated directly, replacing the coarser N(t)<=t log(t)/(2pi) tail.
method_improvements_over_1e21_certificat.segmented_increasing_D_star: Each segment uses the increasing closed D_* lower expression at its left endpoint, rather than the global constant 0.5 or 0.516114.

independent_D_star_certificate.variable_q_refinement: The extended certificate retains q(x)=1-sqrt(2/x), which increases. The earlier uniform proof froze q at q(X_MIN); both agree at X_MIN.

scalar_envelope_barrier_audit.interpretation: The same-point scalar lower envelope changes sign in this bracket. This is a limitation of the present absolute envelope, not a counterexample and not an impossibility theorem for stronger methods.

analytic_lemmas.low_and_B2_endpoint_reduction: The previous upward certificate proves that the low-zero and B2 losses decrease for x>=X_MIN.
analytic_lemmas.high_zero_endpoint_reduction: After scaling, the sharpened high-zero bound is (exp(L/2)+exp(-L/2))*A(L).  The certified derivative margin is positive at X_MIN; its positive term increases and its subtracted rational majorant decreases.
analytic_lemmas.D_star_endpoint_reduction: epsilon decreases; q, J, (1-epsilon)J, -epsilon*A, -x^-1/2, and alpha increase.  Thus the displayed D_* lower expression increases and can be evaluated at each segment left endpoint.
analytic_lemmas.segment_cover: On [a,b], use D_* at a, low-zero/B2 losses at a, and the high-zero loss at b.  Every directed segment clearance is positive.
